comment: Dr. Landy is fantastic. He is an amazing person and an amazing professor. I had a great time in his class.
Landy is a great persona and teacher.  He makes everything interesting and I learned alot. He is a hard grader on papers though. I had him for Alphabet of Human thought
Great teacher. Keeps the class engaged, no boring lectures. VERY smart, knows and likes what he does. I highly recommend him.
He doesn't explain some concepts too thoroughly but overall he teaches what you need to know on the test and you don't have to read the book to keep up. His power points are very helpful in studying.

I had Dr. Landy for Cognitive Science, which definitely is not an easy class.  His teaching, however, was clear and understandable.  He's very knowledgeable, passionate, and willing to help outside of class. He also frequently asks our opinion of the class and will quickly adapt for our benefit.
Dr. Landy is awesome. Actually knows what he's talking about and is passionate about his subject. Also, I personally thought his test was easy, but that's just me.

His test was nearly impossible.  He was a very nice prof but since this was his first year I think he felt like he had something to prove and wanted to make his tests really hard, however you could always go to him for help and he made a real effort to get to know every one in the class.
